text:
emily: Heads up — launch week social plan draft below. Need final copy + assets by EOD today so we can schedule LinkedIn and X threads. Also routing rule for webinar signups: send new leads to /sales/inbound and tag 'webinar-apr'.
emily: High level: 1) Benchmark narrative post (data + chart) on LinkedIn 2) X thread teaser -> webinar signup CTA 3) Post-launch engagement follow-ups (thank you + clip).
rahul: Got it. For the benchmark post, who's owning the chart image? we need alt text and source note.
tess: I can generate the chart PNG from the GA export. Will drop figma + PNG in the assets folder in 30m. Alt text: "per-token latency and cost comparison across models, Redwood inference benchmarks" — ok?
emily: perfect. include short caption: "Faster inference, lower unit cost. We benchmarked across real world prompts — results inside." Keep under 2200 chars for LI.
matt: For X thread, propose 4 tweets: 1) headline stat 2) micro-explain 3) mini-case study + screenshot 4) CTA to webinar. Draft below — feedback pls.
matt: "Tweet 1: New benchmark: same quality, 2x lower token cost. TL;DR: our serving optimizations cut unit costs.
Tweet 2: Key technique: automatic KV caching + latency-aware batching — fewer redundant tokens.
Tweet 3: Customer X cut inference spend 45% after switching to our Dedicated pools (anonymized). [screenshot]
Tweet 4: Live webinar Thurs 2pm PT — sign up: https://redwood.ai/webinar — limited Q&A slots."
olivia: love it. can we add a short hook to tweet 1 like "Engineers: stop overpaying for tokens" ? mild.
rahul: yes but keep it professional. maybe "Engineers: stop overpaying for inference".
tess: adding screenshot with redacted customer logo. uploading to https://figma.com/file/abc123 — will post final PNG here.
emily: Scheduling ask: schedule LI post for Thu 10am PT, X thread Thu 11am PT, reminder tweet Wed 3pm PT. Can social-bot queue that?
social-bot: queued -> platform: Buffer. LI: 2024-04-04T17:00:00Z (Thu 10am PT), X-thread: 2024-04-04T18:00:00Z, Reminder: 2024-04-03T22:00:00Z.
matt: For the X thread, need recommended image sizes (1200x675 for single image card) + alt text.
tess: PNG export at 1200x675 and 1080x1080. Alt for screenshot: "dashboard showing cost reduction after optimizing batching and caching".
rahul: Inbound routing: new webinar leads should hit CRM with utm_source=x_thread for attendees from X. Can we add utm params to the webinar link in tweet 4?
emily: yes — use ?utm_source=x_thread&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch. Tess/matt will embed final link.
matt: Engagement follow-up plan: 1 day after webinar send X thread reply with 30s clip + link to recap blog, 3 days after send LinkedIn DM to registrants who didn't attend with recording. Anyone object?
olivia: no objections. I'll own the DM copy.
emily: Quick approvals: copy below. Please react with :thumbsup: by 3pm or flag changes.
emily: LinkedIn caption draft: "We ran a production inference benchmark across representative workloads — the results surprised us. Join our webinar to see how to cut inference unit costs while keeping latency low. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch"
matt: X thread copy approved from my side.
tess: chart PNG uploaded: https://figma.com/file/abc123/export/chart.png
rahul: I'll update the webinar link with utm_source=x_thread before scheduling.
emily: final checklist: - assets in assets/launch/benchmark/ (tess) - copy approvals by 3pm (everyone) - social-bot schedule queued (social-bot) - routing rules updated in CRM (rahul) - follow-up sequences drafted (olivia)
olivia: I'll post follow-up message drafts to this thread by EOD.
emily: thanks team. If no objections, we'll push to queue at 3:15pm and finalize scheduling. :rocket:
